label: “to” token detector
explanation: This feature fires on the word “to” in all its common token forms (`" to"`, `to`, `To`, `TO`, plus `à` and `unto`), independent of surrounding context. It fires most strongly on the standard lowercase `" to"` token and weakly on case variants, foreign equivalents, or subword occurrences. It does not fire on other words; the apparent preceding-token patterns are just frequent collocations with “to”.
